account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

emailMessage.description: Custom message to include in the notification email. Ignored unless sendNotificationEmail is true.

raw.description: Show (unhide) a range of columns or rows in a sheet (sets hiddenByUser=false). Indices are 0-based and the interval is half-open [startIndex, endIndex) — to unhide a single column/row at position 5, pass startIndex: 5, endIndex: 6.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

endIndex.description: 0-based end index (exclusive); must be greater than startIndex

sheetId.description: Sheet ID (from getSpreadsheetInfo / listSheets). The default first sheet is usually 0.

raw.name: showSheetDimension

raw.description: Style a Docs table in one atomic call: cell borders/background/padding/content alignment (whole table via tableStartLocation, or a cell range subset), fixed column widths, and minimum row heights. Get the real tableStartIndex from the table span line readGoogleDoc or getGoogleDocContent prints (tableStartIndex=N) — never compute it from text offsets. removeBorders: ["all"] unboxes the table (width-0 borders). The API resolves shared edges by applying border updates right-to-left then bottom-to-top.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

borderBottom.description: Cell bottom border. Omitted subfields default to a rendering border: color #000000, width 1pt, SOLID.

borderLeft.description: Cell left border. Omitted subfields default to a rendering border: color #000000, width 1pt, SOLID.

borderRight.description: Cell right border. Omitted subfields default to a rendering border: color #000000, width 1pt, SOLID.

borderTop.description: Cell top border. Omitted subfields default to a rendering border: color #000000, width 1pt, SOLID.

columnIndex.description: Optional cell-subset targeting: first column (0-based); needs rowIndex too

columnIndices.description: Columns (0-based) for columnWidth; omit for all columns

columnSpan.description: Columns in the targeted cell range (default: 1)

ifRevisionId.description: Optional optimistic lock: a revisionId from readGoogleDoc, getGoogleDocContent, getGoogleDocContentPaginated, or getDocumentInfo. The write fails cleanly if the document changed since that read. Valid for 24 hours, and only for the account that read it. Google Docs only.

padding.description: Cell padding on all four edges, in points

removeBorders.description: Border edges to clear via width-0 borders. ["all"] over the whole table = unbox it in one call

rowIndex.description: Optional cell-subset targeting: first row (0-based); needs columnIndex too

rowIndices.description: Rows (0-based) for minRowHeight; omit for all rows

rowSpan.description: Rows in the targeted cell range (default: 1)

tabId.description: Optional. Tab ID containing the table (from listDocumentTabs). If omitted, operates on the first/default tab.

tableStartIndex.description: Start index of the TABLE element, as printed by readGoogleDoc / getGoogleDocContent on the table's span line (tableStartIndex=N)

raw.description: Collapse or expand an existing row or column group. Indices are 0-based and the interval is half-open [startIndex, endIndex). Use listDimensionGroups first to find the group's range and depth.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

collapsed.description: true to collapse the group, false to expand it

depth.description: Nesting depth of the group, 1 for an outermost group (default 1)

endIndex.description: 0-based end index (exclusive); must be greater than startIndex

sheetId.description: Sheet ID (from getSpreadsheetInfo / listSheets). The default first sheet is usually 0.

raw.description: Update an existing Google Doc (replaces all content). The replacement is one atomic batchUpdate, so a failure leaves the document unchanged rather than wiped. For multi-tab docs, specify tabId to replace a single tab's content; leaves other tabs untouched.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

ifRevisionId.description: Optional optimistic lock: a revisionId from readGoogleDoc, getGoogleDocContent, getGoogleDocContentPaginated, or getDocumentInfo. The write fails cleanly if the document changed since that read. Valid for 24 hours, and only for the account that read it. Google Docs only.

tabId.description: Optional. Tab ID to replace (from listDocumentTabs). If set, delete+insert run in a single atomic batchUpdate scoped to that tab.

raw.name: updateGoogleDoc

raw.description: Update an existing Google Sheet. By default uses RAW mode which stores values as-is. Set valueInputOption to 'USER_ENTERED' only when you need formulas to be evaluated.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

valueInputOption.description: RAW (default): Values stored exactly as provided - formulas stored as text strings. Safe for untrusted data. USER_ENTERED: Values parsed like spreadsheet UI - formulas (=SUM, =IF, etc.) are evaluated. SECURITY WARNING: USER_ENTERED can execute formulas, only use with trusted data, never with user-provided input that could contain malicious formulas like =IMPORTDATA() or =IMPORTRANGE().

raw.description: Upload a file (any type: image, audio, video, PDF, etc.) to Google Drive, either from a local path on the server or from base64-encoded content. When fileId is provided, uploads the content as a new version of that existing file (in-place update) instead of creating a new file.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Alternative to localPath for clients without access to the server's filesystem. Provide either localPath or contentBase64.

convertToGoogleFormat.description: Convert uploaded file to Google Workspace format (e.g., .docx to Google Doc, .xlsx to Google Sheet, .pptx to Google Slides). Defaults to false. Not allowed with fileId.

fileId.description: ID of an existing Drive file to update in place: the uploaded content becomes a new version of this file (same ID, revision history preserved). Omit to create a new file.

localPath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload (on the machine running this server). Provide either localPath or contentBase64.

mimeType.description: MIME type (auto-detected from extension if omitted)

name.description: File name in Drive (defaults to local filename; required when creating a new file from contentBase64)

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder ID or path (e.g., '/Work/Projects'). Creates folders if needed. Defaults to root. Not allowed with fileId (use moveItem to move a file).
